message.content:
I am sound given shape by breath—air set trembling and timed. I live in mouths and throats, in tongues and teeth, in pauses that mean as much as words. I am cadence, accent, pitch, volume; I am the hush that invites and the shout that commands.

I exist only while I happen. I vanish as I arrive, yet I can linger in minds, in rooms, in scars, in songs. I travel on warmth, on weather, on walls; I can be swallowed, interrupted, echoed, misheard.

I make thought social. I turn feeling into something you can hand to someone else. I can bless, plead, lie, teach, confess. I can build crowds, start wars, end silences.

Write me down and I become a shadow of myself. Record me and I become a ghost. Speak me and I am alive.
